narrative.text: Krel enters your study carrying a single, damning folder. He sets it on your desk with the quiet precision of a man who has just found the kill shot.

Chancellor. The investigation into opposition campaign funding has uncovered something extraordinary. Dražen Kolvar has been receiving massive, illegal campaign donations from the Tyvaren government. He is not just a rival. He is a Tyvaren asset, bought and paid for to destabilize Veltria from the inside.

We have him dead to rights. But arresting the leader of the opposition for treason right before an election... the international press will call you a dictator eliminating his rival. It makes you look exactly like Halvek.

Kolvar is a traitor. A Tyvaren puppet. I can arrest him and end the opposition overnight. But the optics are catastrophic. The Orythian press will say I am staging a coup. The Halvekists will riot. Or I can leak the documents to Nadia Voss and let the press destroy him. Or I can hold the evidence over his head and make him my puppet. Three paths. None of them clean.

choices.text: Arrest Kolvar for treason. The Republic comes first.
Leak the documents to Nadia Voss. Let the press destroy him.
Hold the evidence over his head. Force him to drop out of the race.
